evidence_span.text: Analysis of mouse embryonic fibroblasts (MEFs) derived from WdpcpCys40 mutant embryos, referred to as WdpcpCys40 mutant MEFs, confirmed a defect in ciliogenesis

reviews.rationale: Model-assessed: Wdpcp loss directly caused ciliogenesis defects, supporting its assigned ciliogenesis role. The embryonic tissues and fibroblasts are indirect to postnatal brain endothelium.

evidence_span.text: NME7 activates γTuRC-mediated microtubule nucleation in vitro.

reviews.rationale: Model-assessed: direct depletion and biochemical experiments establish NME7 as a γTuRC regulator of microtubule nucleation. Support is partial because primary-cilium assembly was not directly tested in the reported experiments.

evidence_span.text: BBS1, BBS2, BBS7, and BBS9 constitute the core subcomplex

reviews.rationale: Model-assessed: gene-specific interaction experiments support BBS9 as a core BBSome component. Support is partial because the SMO/GPR161 trafficking experiments perturb BBS1 rather than BBS9.

evidence_span.text: Our findings place Cc2d2a at this hub in a vertebrate model with direct relevance to a human ciliopathy disease state and support an active role for Cc2d2a as an entry-facilitator

reviews.rationale: Model-assessed: mutant, localization, and Rab8-related experiments support Cc2d2a as a transition-zone entry and trafficking factor. Zebrafish photoreceptors and other ciliated cells are indirect to mouse brain endothelium.
